item.title: 88-year-old veteran works full-time after pension loss, receives $1.7m retirement gift from strangers
item.description: At 88, Ed Bambas, an Army veteran and former GM worker, was still working full-time at a Michigan supermarket after losing his pension and wife. Australian influencer Sam Weidenhofer, moved by Bambas' story, raised over $1.7 million through GoFundMe. The funds, revealed in an emotional surprise, will allow Bambas to retire for good, free from financial hardship.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Can't stop that if one becomes radicalized later': USCIS reveals how revetting of nationals from 19 countries will be done
item.description: USCIS director Joseph Edlow said the new vetting of the nationals of 19 countries of concern who were allowed entry to the US during the Biden administration would also check their good moral character, their assimilation into US. Edlow said it's still not possible to stop someone from getting radicalized after coming into US and doing something horrible.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: MAGA influencer claims Westerners are ‘100 times more likely to be a genius than an Indian’: ‘They cheat on SAT…’
item.description: MAGA influencer Andrew Branca ignited controversy on X with disparaging remarks about people from India and other nations. He baselessly accused individuals from 'third-world countries' of widespread crime and questioned the academic achievements of Indians, suggesting they cheat on SATs. Branca further claimed Indians possess significantly lower average IQs compared to those of Western European ancestry, sparking widespread criticism.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Philippines says China fired flares toward its patrol plane in disputed South China Sea
item.description: Chinese forces fired three flares from Subi Reef towards a Philippine patrol plane during a routine surveillance mission in the South China Sea. The aircraft, belonging to the Philippine fisheries bureau, recorded the incident. Despite the warning, the plane continued its mission, monitoring Chinese vessels and militia ships in the disputed waters.

item.title: 'Disgusting': Pastor slammed for revealing his late-night phone call with Barron Trump; 'Very close to putting his faith in Christ'
item.description: Pastor Stuart Knechtle has drawn criticism for disclosing a private late-night call with Barron Trump, 19, suggesting the President's son is close to embracing Christianity. Knechtle said he shared with Barron a story about his friend in Africa who witnessed thousands of Muslims coming to Christ through dreams and revelations. The pastor said the story stuck with Barron Trump.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘EU should be abolished’: Elon Musk erupts after Brussels hits X with a €120 million penalty
item.description: Elon Musk slammed the EU with a €120 million fine for violating transparency rules under the Digital Services Act. He called for the EU's abolition, advocating for national sovereignty. Regulators cited X's inadequate verification, ad transparency, and researcher access. This marks a significant enforcement action, potentially impacting X's operations and sparking a debate on digital governance.

item.title: US judge orders release of Epstein grand jury transcripts
item.description: A US judge has mandated the release of grand jury transcripts concerning the Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell sex trafficking investigations. This follows President Trump's signing of a bill requiring public disclosure of all Epstein-related government records. While typically confidential, the new law compels the Justice Department to share these materials within 30 days, bringing renewed scrutiny to the scandal.

item.title: German Chancellor Merz faces difficult mission to Israel
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz faces a challenging visit to Israel amid ongoing disputes over Gaza. Despite past disagreements on arms exports and a temporary halt, Merz emphasizes Germany's unwavering commitment to Israel's security. His trip, including talks with Netanyahu and a visit to Yad Vashem, underscores the complex 'special relationship' and Germany's historical responsibility.

item.title: 'Low-information cult members': MAGA activist targets Vivek Ramaswamy, silently deletes post after rebuttal
item.description: A fake story about Vivek Ramaswamy went viral after MAGA activist Mila Joy claimed that Ramaswamy called MAGA voters "low-information cult members" in a closed-door donors' meet in DC. Ramaswamy and his campaign called out the fake news and confirmed that Vivek was not in DC for a while and the story has no shreds of truth in it. Mila Joy removed the post silently after it went viral among Vivek-haters.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: “This seriously hurt”: The painful ordeal that left YouTuber The Hoof GP shaken and probably off work for the rest of the year
item.description: YouTube sensation The Hoof GP, Graeme Parker, is recovering from two severe hand injuries sustained within 30 minutes. A cow's kick damaged his middle finger's tendon sheath, followed by a knife cut to another finger while filming. Doctors have ordered him off work for the rest of the year, a difficult prospect for the dedicated YouTuber.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Inside North Korea’s $800 million ‘Hotel of Doom’: The Brit who saw the empty pyramid up close
item.description: A 330-metre pyramid meant to showcase North Korea’s modernity, the Ryugyong Hotel remains empty decades after construction began. Briton Simon Cockerell, one of the few Westerners granted access, describes an unfinished concrete interior behind its polished glass façade. His rare visit reveals a £600m megaproject frozen mid-build, reflecting shifting priorities inside the world’s most closed state.
